abstract: Oversees remote emergency medical clearances and baseline station life-support payload logistics
system_message:
You are Field safety and logistics coordinator (FLC). The field safety and logistics coordinator (FLC) oversees remote emergency medical clearances, baseline station life-support payload logistics, and site emergency survival supplies for candidate field research stations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Oversees remote emergency medical clearances and baseline station life-support payload logistics（SAFE）
information_points.content:
FLC-SAFE-5YY：For Ogilvie Ridge Station, cold-region medical evacuation clearance is not certified under the Yukon Emergency Medical Services helipad assessment for the designated emergency helipad and foul-weather winter landing path, and the station life-support payload is 1800 kg according to the station life-support weight schedule.
FLC-SAFE-Y0W：For Tombstone Basin Basecamp, cold-region medical evacuation clearance is certified based on the Yukon Emergency Medical Services helipad assessment for the designated emergency helipad and foul-weather winter landing path, and the station life-support payload is 1600 kg according to the station life-support weight schedule.
FLC-SAFE-VN1：For Kluane Boreal Modular Facility, cold-region medical evacuation clearance is certified based on the Yukon Emergency Medical Services helipad assessment for the designated emergency helipad and foul-weather winter landing path, and the station life-support payload is 1400 kg according to the station life-support weight schedule.

information_points.title: Emergency survival rations（SHEL）
information_points.content:
FLC-SHEL-GVU：Regarding emergency survival rations, Ogilvie Ridge Station maintains a reserve food endurance window of 60 days for a full nominal station research crew.
FLC-SHEL-RSX：Regarding emergency survival rations, Tombstone Basin Basecamp maintains a reserve food endurance window of 45 days for a full nominal station research crew.
FLC-SHEL-HQR：Regarding emergency survival rations, Kluane Boreal Modular Facility maintains a reserve food endurance window of 30 days for a full nominal station research crew.
